cs2-dumper generated offsets
  Source: https://github.com/a2x/cs2-dumper
  Only generated headers and build metadata required by this reader are distributed.
  MIT license text is included as cs2-dumper-LICENSE.txt.

hyper-reV transport ABI
  Source: https://github.com/noahware/hyper-reV
  The Hyper-V adapter interoperates with the existing user-mode read/write ABI.
  Upstream GNU GPL version 3 is included as hyper-reV-LICENSE.txt.
  No hypervisor installation, code-hook or memory-hiding functionality is included.

  Original author: wz5200, copyright 2025.
  Process binding and page-read behavior were reviewed against the prior reader.
  The upstream attribution and license are included in Hyper_rw-LICENSE.txt.
